name: City Council Regular Meeting Agenda - Supplemental Packet Posted
agenda_text:
NED E DAVIS  KELLY HONIG  SUSAN McSWEENEY  BRAD HALPERN  RAY PEARL
  Mayor  Mayor Pro Tem  Councilmember  Councilmember  Councilmember

  AGENDA
  Regular Meeting of the City Council
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE
  City Council Chambers
  31200 Oak Crest Drive
  Westlake Village, CA 91361

  WEDNESDAY, JUNE 26, 2024 - 6:30 p.m.

 ATTEND OR WATCH THE MEETING
 Members of the public may attend in-person in the Council Chambers or watch the meeting through
 Zoom, City Website (Live Stream) or Cable TV Channel 10. City Council Chamber doors open 30
 minutes before the meeting start time.

 PUBLIC COMMENT/SPEAKERS
 Members of the public may express comments to the City Council in person at the meeting or may
 submit written comments before or at the meeting. Submit a Public Speaker card or Written
 Comment card to the City Clerk prior to the public comment portion of that item. Public speakers
 are limited to three minutes unless the presiding officer sets a different limit for meeting
 management purposes. An oral summary of written comments may be given at the discretion of
 the presiding officer.

 Written comments may be emailed to the City Clerk's Office at cityclerk@wlv.org no later than 4:00
 p.m. on the meeting date. Written comments will be provided to City Council prior to the meeting
 and posted at https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-Packets

 ZOOM VIEWING ONLY:
 Members of the public watching through Zoom will not have the ability to provide comments on
 agenda items. Zoom is offered strictly as an additional viewing platform. To provide comments, see
 Public Comments/Speakers section.

  https://us02web.zoom.us/j/83092891902
  Webinar ID: 830 9289 1902
  One Tap Mobile:
  +16694449171,,83092891902# OR +16699009128,,83092891902#
  Telephone:
  +1 669 444 9171 OR +1 669 900 9128 OR +1 346 248 7799 OR +1 719 359 4580

 2939375.2
 Unless the City Council holds a teleconference meeting under AB 2449 (2022) guidelines, the
meeting will not be cancelled if technical issues occur.

In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related
modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or
services, please call the City Clerk’s office at (818) 706-1613 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

Any disclosable public records related to an open session item on a regular meeting agenda and
distributed by the City to the City Council less than 72 hours prior to that meeting are available for
public inspection at City Hall (31200 Oak Crest Drive, Westlake Village) during normal business
hours and are posted on the City’s Website - https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-
Packets.

CALL TO ORDER: 6:30 p.m.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE:

ROLL CALL:  Councilmembers Pearl, Halpern, McSweeney, Mayor Pro Tem
  Honig, Mayor Davis

APPROVAL OF AGENDA:

APPROVAL OF MINUTES:

Minutes of June 10, 2024 City Council Closed Session Meeting and June 12, 2024 Regular
Session Meeting Minutes.

SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS/CEREMONIAL MATTERS: None

PUBLIC COMMENTS:
Members of the public may address the City Council on non-agenda items that are within the Council’s subject
matter jurisdiction. Please observe the time limit (three minutes unless a different limit is set by the presiding
officer for meeting management purposes). Public Comments may be presented via a written comment, see
Page 1 for deadline. Complete a Speaker Card and submit it to the City Clerk to be called to speak while in
the Council Chambers.

COUNCIL RESPONSE:

STAFF COMMENTS:

COUNCIL COMMENTS:

2939375.2
 MONTHLY DEPARTMENTAL REPORTS:

1.  Sheriff's Department Report

2.  Fire Department Report

3.  Library Report

4.  Chamber of Commerce Quarterly Oral Report

CITY COUNCIL COMMITTEE REPORTS: None
Reports on City Council Committee meetings held.

PUBLIC HEARINGS:

1.  CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT NO. 14-003; RESOLUTION NO. 2355-24 - Adopt
  Resolution No. 2355-24, determining Modification No. 1 of Conditional Use Permit
  No. 14-003 is exempt from CEQA and authorizing the sale of alcohol for offsite
  consumption in conjunction with the operation of an existing Target located at 30740
  Russell Ranch Road.

  RESOLUTION NO. 2355-24: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  WESTLAKE VILLAGE APPROVING MODIFICATION NO. 1 OF CONDITIONAL USE
  PERMIT NO. 14-003 TO AUTHORIZE THE CONTINUED SALE OF ALCOHOL FOR
  OFFSITE CONSUMPTION AT TARGET LOCATED AT 30740 RUSSELL RANCH ROAD

 2.  SIGN MODIFICATION PERMIT NO. 18-012, MODIFICATION NO. 1;
  RESOLUTION NO. 2356-24 - Adopt Resolution No. 2356-24, determining Sign
  Modification Permit No. 18-012, Modification No. 1 is exempt from CEQA and
  authorize revisions to the existing sign program for the County Line Shopping Center
  to ensure that all new and replacement signage is consistent with the design of the
  approved exterior remodel of the shopping center located at 4601 to 4711 Lakeview
  Canyon Road and 32111 Agoura Road.

  RESOLUTION NO. 2356-24: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  WESTLAKE VILLAGE APPROVING MODIFICATION NO 1. OF SIGN MODIFICATION
  PERMIT NUMBER NO. 18-012, TO AUTHORIZE REVISIONS TO AN EXISTING SIGN
  PROGRAM FOR THE COUNTY LINE SHOPPING CENTER LOCATED AT 4601-4711 &
  32111 AGOURA ROAD

MONTHLY IN-HOUSE DEPARTMENTAL REPORTS:

1.  Engineering Department Report

2.  Planning Department Report

3.  Cultural Recreation Report

2939375.2
 CONSENT CALENDAR: Matters listed under the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine and
will be enacted by one motion and one vote. Unless otherwise requested by a Councilmember, there will be
no separate discussion of these items. If discussion is desired, that item will be removed from the Consent
Calendar and will be considered separately.

  APPROVAL OF WARRANTS: Warrants effective June 15, 2024 in the amount of
  $767,697.94

  GENERAL BUSINESS:

  1. CONTRACT WITH COBRA PROFESSIONAL INC. TO ACT AS THE CITY’S
  THIRD-PARTY  FLEXIBLE  SPENDING  ACCOUNT  PROGRAM
  ADMINISTRATOR - Approve the contract with Cobra Professional Inc. to act as
  the City’s Third-Party Administrator for the Flexible Spending Account Benefit
  Program and authorize the Mayor to execute the contract on behalf of the City.

  2. ADOPTING THE UPDATED ANNUAL INVESTMENT POLICY FOR
  FISCAL YEAR 2024-25 AND DELEGATING AUTHORITY TO THE CITY
  TREASURER TO INVEST AND REINVEST CITY FUNDS; RESOLUTION
  NO. 2357-24 - Adopt Resolution 2357-24 Updating the Annual Investment
  Policy for Fiscal Year 2024-25 and Delegating Authority to the City
  Treasurer to Invest and Reinvest City Funds.

  RESOLUTION NO. 2357-24: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY
  OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE, CALIFORNIA, ADOPTING THE UPDATED ANNUAL
  INVESTMENT POLICY FOR FISCAL YEAR 2024-25 AND DELEGATING AUTHORITY
  TO THE CITY TREASURER TO INVEST AND REINVEST CITY FUNDS

  3. APPROVAL OF A FIVE-YEAR LEASE AGREEMENT WITH PITNEY BOWES
  FOR POSTAGE METER EQUIPMENT - Approve a five-year contract with Pitney
  Bowes for lease of postage meter equipment and authorize the Mayor to execute
  the contract on behalf of the City

  4. ACCEPTANCE OF BUS SHELTER IMPROVEMENT PROJECT; FILE NOTICE
  OF COMPLETION - Accept the Bus Shelter Improvement Project and authorize
  the City Clerk to execute and record a “Notice of Completion” on behalf of the
  City.

  5. PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH CIVIC SOLUTIONS, INC.
  FOR PLANNING SERVICES - Approve the Professional Services Agreement
  with Civic Solutions, Inc., authorize the Mayor to execute the agreement, and find
  that the agreement is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act.

OLD BUSINESS: None

2939375.2
 NEW BUSINESS:

1.  APPROVAL OF A FIVE-YEAR MUNICIPAL LAW ENFORCEMENT SERVICES
  AGREEMENT WITH THE COUNTY OF LOS ANGELES FOR PUBLIC SERVICES
  PROVIDED BY THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY SHERIFF’S DEPARTMENT AND
  AUTHORIZING THE CITY MANAGER TO PROCURE SERVICES OF THE LOS
  ANGELES COUNTY SHERIFF’S DEPARTMENT ANNUALLY UP TO AN
  AMOUNT AUTHORIZED IN EACH OPERATIONS BUDGET ADOPTED FOR THE
  PERIOD OF JULY 1, 2024 THROUGH JUNE 30, 2029; RESOLUTION 2358-24 -
  Adopt Resolution No. 2358-24, Approving A Five-Year Municipal Law Enforcement
  Services Agreement With The County Of Los Angeles For Public Services Provided
  by the Los Angeles County Sheriff’s Department and Authorizing the City Manager
  to Procure Services of The Los Angeles County Sheriff’s Department Annually up to
  an Amount Authorized in Each Operations Budget Adopted For The Period of July
  1, 2024 Through June 30, 2029, and Authorizing The Mayor To Execute The
  Agreement On Behalf Of The City.

  RESOLUTION NO. 2358-24: A RESOLUTION OF THE COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  WESTLAKE VILLAGE, COUNTY OF LOS ANGELES, APPROVING A FIVE-YEAR
  MUNICIPAL LAW ENFORCEMENT SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH THE COUNTY OF
  LOS ANGELES FOR PUBLIC SERVICES PROVIDED BY THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY
  SHERIFF’S DEPARTMENT AND AUTHORIZING THE CITY MANAGER TO PROCURE
  SERVICES OF THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY SHERIFF’S DEPARTMENT ANNUALLY UP
  TO AN AMOUNT AUTHORIZED IN EACH OPERATIONS BUDGET ADOPTED FOR THE
  PERIOD OF JULY 1, 2024 THROUGH JUNE 30, 2029

2.  APPROVAL OF A FIVE-YEAR MUNICIPAL ANIMAL CARE AND CONTROL
  AGREEMENT WITH THE COUNTY OF LOS ANGELES FOR JULY 1, 2024
  THROUGH JUNE 30, 2029 – Approve a Municipal Animal Care and Control
  Agreement with County of Los Angeles for Animal Care and Control Services for the
  period of July 1, 2024 through June 30, 2029 and the Mayor be authorized to execute
  the agreement on behalf of the City

ADJOURNMENT:

This agenda was posted on Friday, June 21, 2024 at 1:00 p.m. on the City’s website and in the
Posting Board at City Hall.

  Deputy City Clerk
  June 21. 2024
